## Notes
- 
- Every merge to `main` cuts a release. By default it's a patch bump
  (`vX.Y.Z` → `vX.Y.(Z+1)`); add the `minor version` label for a minor bump
  (`vX.Y.Z` → `vX.(Y+1).0`). If both labels are applied, `minor version` wins.
